title: Ian S. Ardern
vital_facts: Born 1954, Te Aroha (near Hamilton), New Zealand,
Baptized as a child; Aaronic Priesthood as a youth; Melchizedek Priesthood as a young adult
Married Paula Ann Judd, 1976, Hamilton New Zealand Temple; Four children:
Bachelor's and Master's degrees in education, both from University of Waikato, Hamilton, New Zealand
English teacher, later Principal at Church College of New Zealand; Institute Director/Seminary Coordinator; Pacific Area Director for Church Educational System
Bishop; High Councilor; Counselor to Stake President; Area Seventy.
First Quorum of the Seventy, 2011 - present
